description: Election Commission - Declare that V. W. de Silva was elected as the member of the No. 3, Dandagamuwa Town of Kuliyapitiya Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kuliyapitiya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local authority level, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member's absence from meetings. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members.
